function refusedBy(opts: { refuse: { status: number; code: string } }) {
  return json({ title: "Refused", code: opts.refuse.code }, opts.refuse.status);
}

function reply(s: number, c: string) {
  return json({ code: c }, s);
}
reply(403, "r2_reply_refused"); // want: r2_reply_refused

function reply2(status: number, c: string) {
  return json({ title: "Named", code: c }, status);
